entries.zh: 玉貌；面容美好如玉，形容容貌秀美
entries.en: a beautiful face; a lovely, jade-like countenance

entries.zh: 秀气；清秀文雅，形容人容貌清秀、气质雅致
entries.en: refined and elegant appearance; delicate, well-proportioned beauty

entries.zh: 艳冶；容貌艳丽而带妖娆之态
entries.en: very beautiful; glamorous and alluring (of a woman)

entries.notes: 「美」字调符污损（T99），字义由西语词头 hermoso mucho 与「嬌美」互证。

entries.zh: 娇媚；柔美妩媚，形容女子姿态动人
entries.en: very beautiful; sweetly charming and coquettish
very beautiful; a lovely, charming face
beauty; good looks, handsome or pretty appearance

entries.zh: 妖艳；冶艳妩媚、引人邪思的美色
entries.notes: 首字形作「夭」，与「妖」形近，依 lasciva（淫冶）之义取「妖」解，原字待核。

entries.zh: 窕；体态轻盈美好（多与「窈」连用为「窈窕」）
entries.en: slender, graceful beauty (as in yaotiao, graceful and alluring)
entries.notes: 「窕」单字义依「窈窕」连文及 lasciva 语境推定。

entries.zh: 妖媚；艳丽妩媚，举止轻佻动人
窈窕；体态美好、容貌秀丽而动人
entries.en: graceful and alluring beauty (yaotiao); lovely and seductive
entries.notes: 首字疑「窈」或「窮」，闽南音 iaú 与「窈」相合，且「窈窕」自成词，取「窈」。

entries.zh: 秀；田野草木茂盛秀美，亦指郊野景色之美
entries.en: beauty of the fields; luxuriant, lovely growth in the countryside
luxuriant and flourishing growth; the countryside's lush beauty
delicate, tender new growth; fresh beauty of the fields

entries.zh: 娇；女子柔美可爱的姿容
entries.en: a woman's delicate loveliness; feminine charm

entries.zh: 色；面色、气色，兼指面容的美色
entries.en: complexion; the color and comeliness of the face
entries.notes: 该字调符污损（T99），字形字音可辨，义依 hermosura y color del rostro 定。

entries.zh: 艳色；艳丽的美色、姣好的面色
entries.notes: M 栏「iăm seg. bin sy」以四音节对二汉字，疑「艷色」之外另录「面色」一类异文，兼多处方音符号污损，释义存疑。
